description: This file defines a PHP trait 'StatementIteratorTrait' that implements iterator methods for database statement objects, managing result set iteration, including fetching, rewinding, and validation.

classes.name: StatementIteratorTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing iterator functionality for database statement objects, including methods for managing result set iteration, such as current, key, rewind, next, and valid.

methods.name: markResultsetIterable
methods.description: Sets whether the result set is iterable and resets the current row.

methods.name: setResultsetCurrentRow
methods.description: Sets the current row and increments the row key.

methods.name: getResultsetCurrentRowIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the current row.

methods.name: markResultsetFetchingComplete
methods.description: Marks the result set as no longer fetchable.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current row in the result set.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the key (index) of the current row.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the iterator to the start; throws exception if already started.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next row.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is valid, fetching data if necessary.
